ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary and both distal tips. Three distinct dark focal spots are visible: one at the lower mid-section of the left lobe, one near the left side of the median notch, and one on the inner right lobe near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 70 degrees; depth is roughly 8% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the full trailing edge. Peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 3 to 12 pixels. Notable jagged cluster at the far left distal tip and a series of small, sharp peaks along the outer right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex curvature transitioning to a straight linear trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark circular pixel clusters detected: one prominent spot on the mid-left lobe, two smaller spots proximal to the median notch, and one faint spot on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, vertical tan/orange-colored linear mark located on the inner portion of the left lobe. A faint, thinner horizontal scratch is visible further toward the left wing tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion or small missing segments at both the far left and far right distal tips, breaking the smooth contour of the leading edge curve.
other_distinctive_markers: The tan-colored vertical marking on the left lobe is a highly unique chromatic anomaly against the white base.
